units_note: Drawing units, frame-relative. 5 units = spacing between bus bars. Page and title block measured from ES-011511; page parts measured from Sammy's restyled ES_01 (GND_Section_Devider_REFERENCE).

text.line_spacing_note: Multi-line text (e.g. a termination block's TERMINATION attribute): each extra line adds height x line_spacing_factor. 1.667 is AutoCAD's single line spacing for MText.

group_mounted.note: Measured from NTT-013627 / PRIME-014034 / ES_12. A part too tall for the page is split: column 1 is cut after the last level that fits and the rest continue in a column beside it (FIXED_011511 ES_12, CORRECTED_FIXED_011511 ES_11). column_pitch is A phase to A phase; it is widened if the breakers of neighbouring columns would come closer than column_clearance. continuation_start_gap is from the main bus's nearest phase to where a continuation column starts.

placeholder_sizes.note: PLACEHOLDERS until the real blocks are catalogued. Widths include labels. A single-breaker feeder is drawn like a main breaker, so it uses the same height. group_mounted_width is only used when the feeder block isn't catalogued.

main_bus.note: Bus height positions are the B (middle) phase. content_bottom_y = ground bus (20.94) + 10 clearance.
main_bus.page_break_note: Bus runs past the last divider at a page break (min..max), plus room for the break block's to/from label (placeholder until the block exists).

main_breaker.note: Gaps measured from NTC-013632 / NTT-013628 (breaker 15 from the bus, input about 30 beyond the breaker).
main_breaker.u_turn_note: U-turns for main and single breakers (2026-10-13). When the termination is fed from the other side than the breaker, the bus leaves the breaker, turns, runs u_turn_width to the right and comes back u_turn_termination_rise, where the termination block sits. The turn is just far enough that the termination's text stays u_turn_text_clearance clear of the breaker and its text (sizes from catalog/blocks.json). u_turn_depth is used for the U-turns of a breaker fed on the bus side.

input_output.note: Sammy's input/output block. Not flipped = from/to the bottom; flipped = from/to the top.

bus_break.note: Where a bus is cut (page break, or a too-tall column): 3P_TIDE_R0 sits on the A-phase end (CONN_A), BRACKET_TEXT_R0 stands just past the end, centred on B, with the to/from label. Gap measured from CORRECTED_FIXED_011511 ES_11.
bus_break.tilde_flip_note: Where the bus arrives on a page, the tilde is mirrored with only this flip setting, so its A/B/C letters sit on the incoming side (tested on the block 2026-10-13: Flip state1 mirrors left-right; Flip state2 is for the vertical state).
bus_break.column_label_note: Too-tall split (2026-10-13): the bracket where a column is cut says column_cut_label; the bracket where the next column starts says where the bus comes from (the part below the main bus / above it).

feeder.note: Group-mounted feeder breaker (Sammy's block). Drawn as a LEFT-side breaker; the right-side one is the same block with only `mirror_parameter` turned on (the mirror that goes with `visibility`: MIRROR-3W for 3 PHASE-3 WIRE). The block mirrors about the vertical bus's B phase, as in ES_12. Taps run from each vertical-bus phase to the breaker; the nearest phase's tap is `tap_length` long.
feeder.provision_note: A provision is tapped out like a breaker (taps end where the breaker would connect); its note starts provision_text_gap beyond the tap ends, centred on B. First line is provision_heading (or provision_heading_without_info when the engineer left the info empty), then the engineer's line. From IMS-REFERENCE.
feeder.space_note: A SPACE slot (an unused position, decision 2026-10-19) is drawn like a provision (solid taps out to where a breaker would connect) with just this text, in the same place as a provision's note.

current_transformers.note: CT set block (Sammy's 3_CTS_3L_R1, decision 2026-10-21). On a vertical run (a riser, a tie's run, the base of a group-mounted bus) the CT LEFT states are used, markers CONN_A_L / B_L / C_L; polarity always points toward the source. The program places the set wherever it fits, keeping `clearance` from the bus and the breaker, and fills the CT numbers, shorting-kit number and the meter it goes to.

voltage_taps.note: Voltage tap block (Sammy's 3P_Voltage_Tap, decision 2026-10-22). On a vertical run (a main's incoming feed, between the breaker and the termination) the vertical_state is used, its vertical_markers (A, B, C) on the phases; the wires leave to the right to 'TO FA-n SHEET #'. Each tap keeps `clearance` from the breaker, the next tap and the termination; the run grows to fit. The program fills in the fuse number; the sheet keeps its default until device pages exist.

line_side_breakers.note: A line-side (load-bank) breaker tied into a main breaker's feed in the next section (decision 2026-10-22), measured from Sabey-011475 (52-LBBA into 52-MA-GEN-A). The tie leaves the main's line side nearest the breaker: tie_gap from the main breaker's line-side terminals to the tie's nearest phase (A on top of the tie, staggered, a dot where each phase tees into the riser). The line-side breaker's line-side terminals are gap_to_breaker beyond the tie's outer phase; its output termination gap_breaker_to_output beyond its other end.
